# jsdiff 9.0.0

Unmodified `dist/diff.min.js` and `LICENSE` from the official npm package `diff@9.0.0`.
Source: https://github.com/kpdecker/jsdiff
Package: https://registry.npmjs.org/diff/-/diff-9.0.0.tgz
License: BSD-3-Clause, retained alongside the browser bundle.

The downloaded package was checked against npm's SHA512 integrity value before extracting these two files:
`sha512-svtcdpS8CgJyqAjEQIXdb3OjhFVVYjzGAPO8WGCmRbrml64SPw/jJD4GoE98aR7r25A0XcgrK3F02yw9R/vhQw==`.

TeXScholar uses `diffArrays` with source-preserving TeX/word tokens for local draft and alternative comparison. It does not send text over the network. Packaging consumes these checked-in files without npm installation, downloads or recompilation.
